mapper.update: UPDATE chapter_metrics SET pacing_data=#{args[0]} WHERE novel_id=#{args[1]} AND chapter_no=#{args[2]} AND revision=#{args[3]}
mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM chapter_metrics m JOIN chapters c ON c.novel_id=m.novel_id AND c.number=m.chapter_no AND c.revision=m.revision WHERE c.novel_id=#{args[0]} AND c.number<#{args[1]} AND c.status='ACCEPTED' ORDER BY c.number DESC LIMIT #{args[2]}
